name: Aortic valve semi-tryptic peptide data
prep: All 14,597 deposited rows retained; consecutive F-number technical triplets averaged over observed normalized linear intensities. Nine Control and ten Severe samples. The sample grouping was confirmed by the study analyst on 2026-11-09. No protein fold-change prefilter or imputation.
fasta_note: 1,872-record FASTA recovered by exact UniProt accession; not the original MatrixDB search FASTA. Preserved byte-for-byte.
